cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our show sold no tickets. We can rehearse uninterrupted. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for our deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Even better! We'll hire the pub upstairs. People already go there voluntarily.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've kept the deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful—a touring production! I'll carry the scenery; you bring exact change. We can try the opening scene between stops.
